A/B split is from the ACTUAL captured per-node verify margins — spot-checked 3 forks recomputing margin from raw fr13_fork_margin_dump.jsonl: pid0/pos38 (winner_div node0 margin=0.25 from logprobs 19.0-18.75 -> B), pid1/pos52 (winner_div node2 margin=1.5 from 21.0-19.5, draft==parent_target -> A), pid2/pos36 (split_node8 margin=8.5 from 25.5-17.0, draft==parent_target -> A); classifier read each faithfully. The >1nat/<1nat rule is applied at the correct LCP-divergence node: _deciding_margin uses winner_div_margin = best_path[winner_lcp] (the node where the winning leaf's match stopped past where the spine stopped) for partial-match forks, falling back to split_node_margin only when winner fully matched (winner_lcp>=len(best_path)). For winner_lcp>spine_lcp cases the leaf genuinely out-matched the spine at a confident node (correct A). For the both-lcp=0 tie-break cases the deciding node is the shared root (correct). threshold=1.0 nat applied via margin>threshold. Margin distribution [0.125..9.125] is clearly bimodal at 1.0 with a heavy >3nat A-tail (genuine leaf wins).
